title: Supported Cloud Providers and Integration Capabilities
content:
CloudDash currently supports three major public cloud providers: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Support varies by plan — see the table below.

## AWS Integration

CloudDash connects to AWS via an IAM Role with read-only permissions. Supported AWS services include:

- **Compute:** EC2 (instances, ASGs), ECS, EKS, Lambda
- **Networking:** VPC, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront
- **Storage:** S3 (bucket metrics), EBS volumes
- **Databases:** RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache
- **Monitoring:** CloudWatch metrics and logs, CloudTrail events
- **Security:** IAM credential age alerts, GuardDuty findings

AWS integration is available on Starter, Pro, and Enterprise plans.

## Azure Integration

CloudDash connects to Azure via an Azure Service Principal with Reader role permissions. Supported Azure services include:

- **Compute:** Virtual Machines, AKS, Azure Functions, App Service
- **Networking:** Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, ExpressRoute
- **Databases:** Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure Cache for Redis
- **Storage:** Azure Blob Storage, Azure Files
- **Monitoring:** Azure Monitor metrics, Log Analytics Workspace

Azure integration is available on Pro and Enterprise plans.

## GCP Integration

CloudDash connects to GCP via a Service Account with Monitoring Viewer and Logs Viewer roles. Supported GCP services include:

- **Compute:** Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions
- **Networking:** Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud CDN
- **Databases:** Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Firestore, Cloud Spanner
- **Monitoring:** Cloud Monitoring metrics, Cloud Logging

GCP integration is available on Pro and Enterprise plans.

## Plan vs. Integration Availability

| Provider | Free | Starter | Pro | Enterprise |
|----------|------|---------|-----|------------|
| AWS | — | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Azure | — | — | ✓ | ✓ |
| GCP | — | — | ✓ | ✓ |
| On-premise | — | — | — | ✓ |
| Custom | — | — | — | ✓ |

## Requesting New Service Support

Don't see a service you need? Submit a feature request at https://feedback.clouddash.io. Enterprise customers can request priority integrations through their dedicated Customer Success Manager.
